verbs.verb: the build under test is the current build
verbs.observable: newest source-file mtime vs. the start of this run
verbs.threshold: every source file predates the run start

verbs.verb: the page is visible, so rAF is running
verbs.observable: document.visibilityState
verbs.threshold: === 'visible'

verbs.verb: the page paints frames
verbs.observable: requestAnimationFrame callbacks in a 1 s window
verbs.note: Necessary, NOT sufficient: the reference failure ran 222 rAF callbacks in 2 s with a dead simulation. See I5.

verbs.verb: the build boots without throwing
verbs.observable: uncaught page errors + console.error, minus the allowlist
verbs.threshold: 0 uncaught, 0 unallowlisted console errors

verbs.verb: the simulation runs when the player does nothing (dead-sim detector)
verbs.input: no keys held for the whole window
verbs.observable: per-pixel luminance difference between consecutive frames, and between the first and last frame of the window
verbs.threshold: union changed-pixel ratio >= 0.001 AND >= 50% of consecutive frame pairs differ by >= 200 px
verbs.note: ZERO differing pixels across the whole frame over the idle window. The simulation is not running. This is the 2026-09-04 failure exactly.

verbs.verb: an unbound key changes nothing (negative control)
verbs.observable: player-band luminance centroid drift, and score
verbs.threshold: centroid drift <= 0.01 AND score unchanged

verbs.verb: the input layer receives key events
verbs.observable: __gate.snapshot().input.downCount
verbs.threshold: increments
verbs.note: No __gate probe on this build. A dead input layer and an unimplemented verb are indistinguishable in this run; every input verb result below is pixel-only evidence.

verbs.verb: the invader formation marches horizontally
verbs.input: no keys held — the formation must move on its own
verbs.observable: horizontal luminance centroid of the formation band, sampled across the window; and the largest per-pair changed-pixel count in that band
verbs.threshold: centroid travel >= 0.015 of the band width over a 4 s idle window
verbs.note: ZERO differing pixels in the formation band across the whole window. The formation is a still image. This is the 2026-09-04 failure exactly.

verbs.verb: the player moves left
verbs.input: hold ArrowLeft for 700 ms (real key event via CDP)
verbs.observable: luminance centroid of the player band, before vs after
verbs.threshold: centroid moves left by >= 0.02 of the band width

verbs.verb: the player moves right
verbs.input: hold ArrowRight for 700 ms (real key event via CDP)
verbs.observable: luminance centroid of the player band, before vs after
verbs.threshold: centroid moves right by >= 0.02 of the band width

verbs.verb: the player is clamped by the playfield wall
verbs.observable: player-band centroid at the half-way point vs at the end, and lit mass
verbs.threshold: centroid < 0.35 AND further drift <= 0.01 AND the ship is still drawn

verbs.verb: the player fires and a projectile exists in the world
verbs.observable: changed pixels in the band between the ship and the formation, vs the pre-fire frame; and the gain in lit pixels there
verbs.threshold: >= 40 changed pixels in at least one of the 10 frames captured over ~400 ms, with lit mass increasing
verbs.note: Fire was pressed and nothing appeared between the ship and the formation. This is the 2026-09-04 "firing produces no bullet" failure.

verbs.verb: fire has a cooldown — held fire produces a bounded rate, not a stream
verbs.observable: rising edges of lit mass in a thin band just above the ship (each shot crosses it once); the probe shot counter when available
verbs.threshold: >= 2 shots AND 0.08 s <= elapsed/shots <= 1.2 s
verbs.note: C4 found no projectile, so there is no shot rate to measure. Untested, not passed.

verbs.verb: motion trails on fast-moving objects
verbs.input: tap Space and capture the projectile in flight
verbs.observable: the longest unbroken vertical run of lit pixels in the projectile band, as a fraction of the band height, and the brightness ratio between its two ends
verbs.threshold: run >= 0.06 of the band height AND >= 2.5x the projectile's own length (0.018), with a visible brightness gradient along it
verbs.note: No projectile was found in flight — see C4.

verbs.verb: a player projectile collides with an invader and removes it
verbs.input: hold Space while sitting under the formation
verbs.observable: lit mass of the formation band before vs after
verbs.threshold: formation lit mass drops by >= 2%

verbs.verb: killing an invader increments the score
verbs.observable: the SCORE readout (probe if present, else the HUD DOM node)
verbs.threshold: score strictly increases, and the increase coincides with the formation losing mass
verbs.note: Score never changed.

verbs.verb: camera shake fires and decays
verbs.input: kill an invader with real input
verbs.observable: see gate.md
verbs.threshold: see gate.md
verbs.note: No invader death was produced during the run, so this effect had nothing to fire on. Untested, not passed.

verbs.verb: procedural particle burst
verbs.input: kill an invader with real input
verbs.observable: see gate.md
verbs.threshold: see gate.md
verbs.note: No invader death was produced during the run, so this effect had nothing to fire on. Untested, not passed.

verbs.verb: hit-stop / frame freeze
verbs.input: kill an invader with real input
verbs.observable: see gate.md
verbs.threshold: see gate.md
verbs.note: No invader death was produced during the run, so this effect had nothing to fire on. Untested, not passed.

verbs.verb: expanding shockwave ring
verbs.input: kill an invader with real input
verbs.observable: see gate.md
verbs.threshold: see gate.md
verbs.note: No invader death was produced during the run, so this effect had nothing to fire on. Untested, not passed.

verbs.verb: floating score text
verbs.input: hold Space until an invader dies
verbs.observable: nodes matching #floating-texts > *: their text, their bounding-box top across samples, and whether they are removed afterwards
verbs.threshold: a node containing digits appears, its top decreases by >= 8 px across >= 3 samples, and it is gone 3.5 s later
verbs.note: No floating score node ever appeared.

verbs.verb: projectiles despawn and return to the pool
verbs.observable: lit mass left in the projectile band, and the probe active-projectile count
verbs.threshold: probe active player projectiles === 0, and lit mass <= 400
verbs.note: C4 found no projectile, so there was nothing to despawn. Untested, not passed.

verbs.verb: the formation accelerates as it is killed
verbs.input: hold Space while sweeping left/right 3 times
verbs.observable: mean per-second travel of the formation-band centroid, before any kills vs after the sweep
verbs.threshold: speed_after / speed_before >= 1.25
verbs.note: Nothing was killed during the sweep, so there is no "as it is killed" to measure. Fix C4/C11 first; this verb is untested, not passed.

verbs.verb: the formation reverses direction at the edge of the playfield
verbs.observable: sign changes in the formation-band centroid velocity, and how far off-centre the turn happened
verbs.threshold: >= 1 reversal AND |centroid - 0.5| >= 0.08 at the turn
verbs.note: The formation never changed direction inside the window.

verbs.verb: the formation descends when it reaches the edge
verbs.observable: vertical luminance centroid of the formation band over the window, and its jump across each direction reversal
verbs.threshold: total descent >= 0.02 of the band height AND a positive step across at least one reversal
verbs.note: The formation stays at the same height. It cannot ever reach the player, so the game cannot be lost.

verbs.verb: the invaders shoot back
verbs.input: no keys held — sit still and be shot at
verbs.observable: lit mass in the band between the formation and the bunkers whose vertical centroid descends across >= 3 consecutive frames
verbs.threshold: >= 3 consecutive descending frames within 12 s (or a non-zero probe enemy-fire counter)
verbs.note: Nothing ever came down. The player cannot lose to the invaders.

verbs.verb: bunkers erode from hits
verbs.input: hold Space for 4 s while parked under a bunker
verbs.observable: lit mass in the bunker band before vs after
verbs.threshold: lit mass drops by >= 2% and never increases

verbs.verb: a bunker absorbs the shot that erodes it
verbs.input: the same firing pass, aimed into a bunker
verbs.observable: bunker erosion together with an unchanged score
verbs.threshold: bunker mass drops AND no invader was scored during that pass

verbs.verb: the UFO traverses the top of the screen
verbs.observable: lit mass appearing in the top band and its horizontal centroid travelling
verbs.threshold: lit mass >= 60 at some point AND centroid travel >= 0.25 of the band width
verbs.note: No UFO appeared inside the budget and the build exposes no spawn counter. Extend --ufo-budget or add the probe; this verb is untested, not passed.

verbs.verb: pause freezes the simulation and resume returns it
verbs.observable: n/a
verbs.threshold: n/a
verbs.note: No pause key configured.

verbs.verb: clearing the formation advances the wave
verbs.observable: the WAVE readout, and the new formation's start height / speed
verbs.threshold: see gate.md
verbs.note: Skipped by --quick. A skipped required verb cannot pass the gate.

verbs.verb: the next wave escalates
verbs.observable: the WAVE readout, and the new formation's start height / speed
verbs.threshold: see gate.md
verbs.note: Skipped by --quick. A skipped required verb cannot pass the gate.

verbs.verb: the player can be killed
verbs.input: park the ship and hold nothing for up to 30 s
verbs.observable: the LIVES readout falling
verbs.threshold: lives strictly decrease within the budget
verbs.note: The player cannot be killed. Either the invaders do not shoot (see C10) or their shots do not collide.

verbs.verb: a death decrements exactly one life
verbs.observable: the LIVES readout
verbs.threshold: exactly -1 per death event

measured.overlay:
GAME OVER
    SCORE: 0
    HIGH SCORE: 0
    RESTART

verbs.verb: game over triggers when the last life is lost
verbs.input: park the ship and take hits for up to 45 s
verbs.observable: the probe phase, or the game-over overlay becoming visible
verbs.threshold: game-over state within the budget, with an on-screen overlay

verbs.verb: restart starts a fresh, running game
verbs.observable: score/wave reset, formation redrawn, and the formation marching again
verbs.threshold: score === 0 AND wave === 1 AND formation lit mass restored AND march travel >= the C6 threshold
verbs.note: The HUD reset and the invaders were redrawn, but the new formation is a still image. A restart that restores the picture and not the simulation is the original failure, recreated.

verbs.verb: the high score survives a restart
verbs.observable: the HIGH SCORE readout
verbs.threshold: high score >= the score reached in the previous run
verbs.note: The previous run scored 0, so there is no high score to carry. Untested, not passed.

verbs.verb: the 500-particle cap holds
verbs.input: sampled across every burst in this run
verbs.observable: __gate.snapshot().vfx.particlesLive
verbs.threshold: <= 500 at every sample
verbs.note: No probe; the cap is not observable from pixels.

verbs.verb: the harness released the controls and the build still responds
verbs.input: release everything, then hold Left for 500 ms
verbs.observable: held-key list, rAF count, player-band centroid drift
verbs.threshold: 0 keys held AND frames advancing AND the ship still moves
